provenance_note: Source bundle and experiment paths identify historical project artifacts, not runtime dependencies. All runtime source files and model artifacts are included in this package. The P2 lookup and item encoder are rebuilt from the training records.

execution_modes.frozen: Load the saved full-training estimators; rebuild features; predict.
execution_modes.refit: Clone the saved pipeline configurations; fit on all 10,000 training rows; predict. Refit models are used in memory and do not overwrite the saved artifacts.
